params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: request  Priority: P2
Summary: A new list of sources was sent for the Observatory. Most of it is already in as proposals since the list of 20 October; eight sources are new and should come in the same way, so a person can trial and admit them on the Sources page.

Source: Portal mail:42.

## What was sent

About thirty links in three groups: public data (Eurostat Statistics Explained pages on young people, an OECD Education at a Glance table, a World Bank indicator), trade coverage and Substack newsletters on culture and strategy, and web pages (Pinterest Business, Pinterest Predicts, CIM State of the Union 2026, Gallup's Generation Z topic).

## Already held

Checked against `research/source-list-2026-10-20.json`, which `bin/import-source-list.mjs --apply` read in as proposals on 21 October 2026 (pipeline #358):

- The four Eurostat Statistics Explained pages (GT-BL46 to GT-BL49), the OECD school-to-work table DF_LSO_TRANS (GT-BL50) and the World Bank NEET indicator SL.UEM.NEET.ZS (GT-BL51), as reference rows.
- WWD (GT-021) and Ad Age (GT-678).
- ICYMI (GT-638), The Gen Zer (GT-743), In Bed With Social (GT-744), just vibes (GT-745), The New New (GT-746), Post-Culture (GT-747).
- Pinterest Business blog, Dutch edition (GT-748), Pinterest Predicts (GT-711), CIM (GT-427), Gallup News: Generation Z (GT-749).

These need nothing new in the pipeline. Whether each one is proposed, on trial or admitted on the box is not readable from the workbench.

## New

Eight sources, each with a working feed (checked 9 November 2026, all published in the last six weeks):

| Source | Feed |
|---|---|
| Press Gazette | https://pressgazette.co.uk/feed/ |
| Studio Elsewhere | https://studioelsewhere.substack.com/feed |
| Alive in Social Media | https://aliveinsocialmedia.substack.com/feed |
| The Trend Report | https://1234kyle5678.substack.com/feed |
| Codes of Culture (Future+) | https://codesofculture.futureplus.xyz/feed |
| Considered Chaos | https://eugenehealey.substack.com/feed |
| Fashion Tingz | https://fashiontingz.substack.com/feed |
| Future Narrative | https://futurenarrative.substack.com/feed |

The last five were sent as single posts (substack.com/inbox links); the publication behind each post is the source.

## What is asked

A second list in the same format, read with the same importer, so the eight come in proposed and inactive. Nothing is collected until a person starts a trial.

Not in this issue: the single report pages (CIM State of the Union 2026, Pinterest Predicts 2026). A report goes on the shelf through the Studio's Reports upload, as a PDF.
params.title: Take in eight new sources from the source list of 9 November 2026
